learning_objective: 🎯 Explore India's amazing geographical location on the world map and discover the friendly countries that share our borders and cultural history!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: India is a giant, beautiful country located in the southern part of Asia. The bottom half of India is a peninsula, which means it is surrounded by ocean water on three sides!
If we look up to the north, the mighty Himalayan mountains act as a giant wall. Beyond and within these mountains, we share borders with China, Nepal, and the tiny, magical kingdom of Bhutan.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🌅 Neighbours in the East and West
main_concepts.simple_explanation: To our west lies Pakistan, a country that shares a lot of history with us. On the eastern side, we have Bangladesh and Myanmar, where lush green forests and rivers flow across our borders.
Look down into the Indian Ocean! Just a short boat ride away are our island neighbours: Sri Lanka, shaped like a teardrop, and the Maldives, a beautiful chain of tiny coral islands.
We do not just share land borders; we share food, festivals, and history! For thousands of years, people have traveled across these borders to trade spices, silk, and exciting new ideas.

fun_activity.title: 🧭 The Great Border Map Quest!
fun_activity.instructions: Take a blank map of Asia and use different colored crayons to shade India and its 7 land neighbours. See if you can spot which neighbour is the smallest!

quick_recap: ⭐ India is located in South Asia and is surrounded by water on three sides.
⭐ We share land borders with Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar, and Bangladesh.
⭐ Sri Lanka and the Maldives are our beautiful island neighbours in the Indian Ocean.
⭐ Countries connected by geography often share similar cultures, foods, and traditions.
